description: Crypto options chain (Deribit) for one underlying and expiry: calls/puts by strike with bid/ask/mark (native and USD), mark IV, calculated Black-76 delta, open interest (coins and USD notional) and 24h volume. Lists every available expiry. Underlyings: BTC and ETH (deep; inverse and USDC-linear books), SOL, XRP, HYPE, AVAX, TRX (USDC-linear, thin). Defaults: next expiry, strikes within ±10% of spot, both types.

expiry.description: "next" (default), a date like "2026-12-25", or an exchange code like "25DEC26".

moneyness_pct.description: When no strike bounds are given: keep strikes within ± this % of spot. Default 10.

name: options_chain
title: Options Chain
